verified_contracts: Existing owner/store and original CAS mutation reused; ordinary PUT shape unchanged.
History metadata response is bounded, strict positive anchored cursors; persisted full-history memory and legacy records costs remain unchanged.
Historical identity/scope/creator/version validation; malformed/duplicate/bool versions rejected.
Historical cue validation checks normalized digest to reject lossy string/numeric coercion; no approval/task authority copied.
Historical own segment/speaker/source pins revalidated on preview and inside original CAS update; manual-edited or empty replacement does not bypass pin.
Original target media/asset/timebase/plan binding retained; source equivalence only, no whole-plan historical revision claim.
Read pre/post authorization/currentness and no-store route wrapper reused.
Explicit local replacement, dirty/split warning, provenance persistence, equal-cue no-op, failure draft retention and late/ABA/retained handler fences.
Shared primitives/classes used; no token/shell/protected UI source changed.

origin_proof.summary: Normal startup requires unset outer PYTHONPATH; actual original runner child uses its provided current-worktree PYTHONPATH. PathFinder traverses actual sys.path and returned package paths; no product imports in proof. Clean reconciliation interpreter only.

limitations: File/in-process TestClient and jsdom synthetic fixtures only. No real browser, screenshot geometry, socket server, PostgreSQL, model/provider, FFmpeg/live quality, release or push claim.
Backend r1 failed two aliases of an invalid new fixture; preserved raw failure and corrected only fixture to mounted direction change.
Current protected count 1285 includes earlier 1279 subset plus newer protected additions; it is not a test execution count.
